Your site says "Known for windows." Your customers talk about insulation and weatherization. 36 of your 48 written Google reviews are about attics, floors and crawl spaces. 4 are about windows or doors, and the newest is from 2022.
Your site also has no phone number and every inner page says "Page Not Found". So we rebuilt it around the work your customers describe: crews that explain the job and leave the house clean.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Insulation Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page of the demo: what costs you calls today, and how the demo fixes it.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The first page people see, and the one Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: There is no phone number anywhere on the page, so someone on a phone ready to call has nothing to tap.
The word "Wichita" appears nowhere on the page, so Google can't tell you serve Wichita.
The headline says "Known for windows" while most of your reviews are about insulation, so people searching for insulation never see you.
The page is set to a desktop width, so phones show it shrunken.
fixes: Your number, (316) 263-0711, is a one-tap call on every page.
A headline that says insulation and window company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
Real reviews from your customers, each beside the point it proves.
cards.alsoAdd: Hourly speed monitoring that keeps your site fast for visitors on phones, and speed is something Google uses to rank you.

cards.title: Window Replacement
cards.why: Windows lead your site, and they have no page of their own.
problems: The "Vinyl Windows" tile opens a Page Not Found page.
Nothing explains how a window job goes, including a 7-week install quoted at 14 to 18.
fixes: A full page for window replacement in Wichita, KS.
The estimate, the timeline and install day explained, with a review beside each.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Insulation & Weatherization
cards.why: Insulation and weatherization are three quarters of your written reviews, and your site mentions them only in passing.
problems: Insulation shows up once in a banner and once in a sentence, with no page, so homeowners searching for it don't find you.
Your weatherization program jobs and furnace and AC work are not mentioned.
Siding opens a dead page and Roofing has no link.
fixes: A full page for insulation and weatherization in Wichita, KS.
Program jobs, furnace and AC, and real jobs told in your customers' words.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn't think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: The page where interest turns into a call.
problems: The Contact link opens Page Not Found: no form, no number, no address, no hours.
fixes: A real contact page with your number one tap away.
A short list of what to have ready when you call.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

closing.heading: Want a website like this for your business?
closing.text: Your customers already say your crews explain the work and leave the house clean. You likely do more than we found, so on your onboarding call we confirm the full list of services and every detail with you and your team.

onboardingQuestions: Owner: BBB says Heath Marx, one review has Heath doing a window estimate, and an older record may say Kirby Stucky. Who owns the company, and how should the owner be introduced?
Founding year: the site says since 2014, BBB says founded 1998. Which do you want shown?
Phone: (316) 263-0711 matches Google, BBB and Hitachi. Is (316) 832-1004 a second line or old?
Street address, hours and an email to show: 3949 N Bridgeport Cir, Wichita is on Google and BBB; other listings show Park City and S Laura St.
Full list of services: roofing, siding, remodeling and sliding patio doors have little or no review evidence.
Hitachi: authorized dealer of mini-split and VRF systems? Any tier or certification?
Window brand and warranty in writing. A 2019 review says a lifetime warranty was not honored, so no warranty is claimed.
Are estimates free? Is financing offered?
How far do crews travel? Reviews place work in Newton and Parsons.
Licensing, insurance, roofing license and BBB details to verify and show.
Typical window timelines: the 7-week job is one review.
May we name crew leads on the site? Reviewers praise them by name.
Who answers the phone and returns voicemails? Two reviews (2019, 2025) report unanswered calls.
